summary.text: Richie Yow is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 53, who assumed office in 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
According to Ballotpedia, his professional experience includes service in the U.S. Air Force and the Air National Guard.

paragraphs.text: Yow was assigned to the Invitations and Memorial Resolutions Committee and the Ways and Means Committee for the 2025-2026 session, according to Ballotpedia.
The Republican primary for District 53 scheduled for June 9, 2026 was canceled.
